message: 諦めの悪い天使

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Azel. About yesterday... I really think you ought to apologize properly to Roro」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Picking on a first-year is so immature~ Not that I'm one to talk, since I'm a kid~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the same age!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you hate curry and rice, Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why didn't you eat it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though it's delicious」

name: Azel
message: 「S-Shut up」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet it tastes way better than that Vandine Jelly you're drinking」

name: Azel
message: 「Mind your own business」
No good. I can't get through to him at all.

name: Azel
message: 「......What could any of you possibly understand......」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, what a stubborn jerk」
Just like that, Azel boycotted class.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, you should go... cheer Roro up」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lately, it seems like you two... have been getting along pretty well, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Wha, you think so......\s03」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yikes--」

name: Synn
message: 「Gyaaah!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You total blockhead!! Is this any time to be daydreaming?!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's your deal?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Supporting everyone on the Student Council is the president's job, isn't it!」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, that includes you too, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not in any trouble, so I'm fine!! Come on, shoo, shoo」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's your deal?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-saaan!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte?」
The way she made her entrance was completely identical to yesterday.
Her actions, too, and what she was holding.

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪ It's curry rice taught directly by Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「You can already make it on your own!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We did make so much of it, after all. It seems my body remembered how, ehehe.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With this, I can even make breakfast at Mr. President's house now♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Red aleeert! Now Nana-chan's only advantages left are her boob size and how long she's known him--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin. Let's take a quick trip to Prier.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What, whaaat, are you gonna treat me to cake--?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just how sweets-brained are you!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're the last person I wanna hear that from, Nana-chan--\s06」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Today's daily lunch special was bitter melon stir-fry, wasn't it.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Eek! N-Not that... Kyaaa!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, where is Azel-san?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President? Is something wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, n-no... Lolotte, even after what happened yesterday, well」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. To borrow the shrine maiden's words, I was caught off guard yesterday. I must train even harder」

name: Synn
message: 「And so you went and made it again today」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. According to the guidebook, it seems Azel is a 'tsundra'」

name: Synn
message: 「Tsun... dra...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is why she simply struggles to be honest with herself, when in truth she is a very kindhearted person. Most likely, probably」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
Even after getting hurt that badly yesterday, Lolotte hadn't learned her lesson at all.
If anything, it felt like she'd grown even bigger.
Well, that guidebook does have some good advice in it every now and then.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It says the key to clearing the route is to relentlessly stalk the heroine. Apparently, this level of difficulty is quite popular nowadays」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, where is Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「She's been skipping class all morning」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aha~ I bet she is wandering around that area again」

name: Synn
message: 「That area... Wait, you know where she is?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Despite how I may look, I am not merely exploring blindly」
If it's Azel, I'd guess she's probably at the church, though...

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? The pool?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since there do not seem to be many people here at this hour, I often spot her around this area」
Azel at the pool? No way. What could she possibly be doing here?

name: Lolotte
message: 「See, just as I said」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So this is how you conquer a route--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, it is time for lunch~!」

name: Azel
message: 「I told you I don't need it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You haven't even said anything yet~」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you want a repeat of yesterday?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do you hate curry rice, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I hate it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's a lie!! You've never even eaten it!!」

name: Azel
message: 「H-How do you know that?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I won't allow picky eating without even trying it. While we're at it, why don't we settle right here and now whether you like it or not?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I made it for you, Azel. Won't you please eat some?」

name: Azel
message: 「Argh, fine...... I get it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Only one bite, got it?」
When it comes to eating boxed lunches, nothing beats eating under the open sky!!

name: Synn & Lolotte
message: 「Let's eat~♪」

name: Azel
message: 「Let's, eat......」
Lolotte and I both stare at Azel.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So excited, my heart's pounding\s07」

name: Azel
message: 「......D-Don't stare at me so much」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawa, I'm so sorry~」
Lolotte sticks her tongue out playfully.
Gripping my extra-large cabbage bread, I too gulp hard and watch Azel's every move.
He scoops up some curry with his spoon and brings it toward his mouth.

name: Azel
message: 「I told you, stop watching!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry!」
The decisive moment. Somehow, I just can't look away.
Lolotte and I pretended to eat our own food while watching Azel out of the corner of our eyes――

name: Azel
message: 「...Chomp」
She ate it!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uhh?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Really, really?! There's still plenty more, so please eat lots and lots♪」

name: Azel
message: 「Delicious! This is delicious!」
Saying that, Azel kept devouring the curry rice single-mindedly.
In the end, Lolotte even offered up her own portion, and Azel――

name: Azel
message: 「Phew...」
Ate every last bit of it. Why do all angels have black holes for stomachs like this?

name: Synn
message: 「I'm glad it worked out, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, awawa...」
Still, it looks like she couldn't hide her own hunger after all.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauuu~~\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's split my extra-large cabbage bread in half」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa, are you sure!? Thank you so much~\s04」

name: Azel
message: 「That second helping was your portion? Why didn't you say so」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because you were eating it with such gusto」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When you made such a happy face, I just couldn't help myself... ehehe」

name: Azel
message: 「I made... a happy face, you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. After someone treats you to delicious food, you put your gratitude into it and say 'Thank you for the meal'」

name: Azel
message: 「I see, understood」

name: Azel
message: 「Thank you for the meal」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hope you enjoyed the meal~♪」

name: Azel
message: 「Why... why does she make such a face? All I did was serve a meal and receive mere words of gratitude in return.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why does she wear an expression so full of happiness?」

name: Azel
message: 「Even I...」

name: Azel
message: 「Could even I become like that...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san?」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh...! Uugh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!?」
Suddenly, Azel collapses weakly right on the spot.
I caught her before she hit the ground.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Anyway, to the infirmary...!」

name: Synn
message: 「How's Azel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, it seems she has managed to calm down.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. That's a relief.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That scared the crap out of me. I thought something was slipped into that curry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. Even as a joke, that's going too far」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmph. I don't want to hear that from a panda who's always hiding.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I just can't deal with her...」

name: Synn
message: 「So what's the real cause?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Perhaps her spiritual constitution is still too strong, and she hasn't been able to adapt properly. Besides--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san has been working all alone up until now to do something about Re-Crea, after all...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Her body must be far more exhausted than we think...」

name: Synn
message: 「On top of not being able to adapt?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. That's why she must be backed into a much more dangerous situation than Amyrina or I could ever compare to.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Isn't there anything we can do to help him with that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In the end, Mr. Azel's duty is the same as the Crusaders' goal. Which means, you see?」

name: Synn
message: 「...! So that's it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! We just need to take Mr. Azel's place!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, aren't we already trying our best to do that right now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's try even harder! So much so that we surpass Mr. Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「But if we overdo it... then Lolotte will end up just like Azel--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll be fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「What makes you so sure?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because right by my side--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have you with me, President!」
